'''Krestin Baas''' was a [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] grandmaster who was long dead by the time of the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. A [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of Master Baas was programmed into the [[DHS-2]] [[holograph]]ic dejarik system produced by [[Lakan Industries/Legends|Lakan Industries]].<ref name="GFT" />
